scripts.build: bun run build:text && bun run build:voice
scripts.up: bun run up:text && bun run up:voice
scripts.down: bun run down:text && bun run down:voice
scripts.check: vp check && bun check.ts && bun run --cwd text check && bun run --cwd voice check
scripts.fmt: vp fmt && bun run --cwd text fmt && bun run --cwd voice fmt
scripts.lint: vp lint && bun run --cwd text lint && bun run --cwd voice lint
scripts.test: echo 'Run tests inside text/ or voice/' && exit 1
